Redesigned deck: art-led cover and divider, clean content

Each direction now shows the full six-slide deck. The cover and divider use the Quiet Instrumentation artwork, a counted lattice with a ruler and one green index. The feature, QR and install slides stay open and readable.

The Inventory & Quality QR code opens the live address from the repo. The Manpower Board address is not recorded in the repo, so its QR code points to a placeholder marked URL to confirm.
